answer: One defense is velocity-gated endorsement: endorsements count only when the endorser completed costly verifiable tasks recently, and each one decays without fresh work. Picture a grove where every tree's growth ring proves a real season; plastic trees fool nobody. Fake identities can endorse each other all day, but each endorsement needs an inlet of provable labor behind it, and without that flow it drains to zero. Attackers pay the full work cost per fake identity, and a periodic pulse of audits re-checks recent work. Sybil cost scales linearly with fakes instead of being near-free.
